events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: MTV's Legacy
angles.copy: Remember when music videos ruled the airwaves? On this day in 1981, MTV launched, changing music and TV forever. What was the first video you ever saw on MTV?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album, Definitely Maybe, on August 29, 1994, marking a pivotal moment in Britpop history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Turns 32
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. What's your favourite legendary festival moment?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977, but would have been 91 today.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91. His music lives on.

events.title: Tupac Shakur would have been 55
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas, passing away six days later on September 13. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur on the anniversary of the tragic shooting that led to his passing. He would have been 55 and his influence on music is undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and its famous album cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Turns 57
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tunes... what's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday on September 7, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' on September 9, 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine Album Turns 55
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A song and album that still resonate deeply today. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how people listened to music forever.

angles.name: The iPod Turns 25
angles.copy: Remember the first time you put '1,000 songs in your pocket'? Today marks 25 years since Apple launched the original iPod. A true game-changer.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 007's cinematic debut. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday on October 9, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical directions.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped. A double album full of diverse sounds and experimental genius. What's your favourite track?
